name: P0-P6 diagnosis brief (supersedes the B4/B5 + A ordering)
decided: Superseded by the user's P0-P6 brief. The framing is corrected: this is weak GENERALIZATION plus oracle/value error, not absence of learning. P0 blocks all further full training.

steps.title: Finish ablation_dev seeds 43/44 and report the selection-panel inflation
steps.detail: Compare the ablation_dev gain against the locked val gain across three seeds; the single-seed figures were +12.2 and +3.8.

progress.note: three seeds on both panels; inflation 3.2x, per-seed ranges disjoint

steps.summary: ablation_dev overstates the relearning gain by 3.2x (+10.5 pts vs +3.3 pts on locked val), stable across seeds 42-44 with disjoint per-seed ranges

steps.title: Build one derived results table for every arm
steps.detail: Every arm, both panels, per benchmark, rebuilt from artifacts so no figure is retyped.

progress.note: derived results table built; every arm, three panels, per-benchmark; gaps named

steps.summary: scripts/build_results_table.py rebuilds every figure from artifacts; 7 tests pin derivation, missing-evaluation naming and sealed refusal

steps.title: Write the prompt-copying finding up in full
steps.detail: The 46% of humaneval records stating a killing value, the 44-46% copied kills, and SFT doubling the copy rate.

progress.note: paused before any B3 content was written; no partial draft exists to reconcile
corrected a pooling bug that overstated the giveaway effect; three-way stratification, doc written

steps.summary: prompt-copying finding written up: 46% of humaneval records state a killing value, 44-46% of adev kills are copies, but the counterfactual advantage is only +3.11/+6.50 points

steps.title: Record assertion count and shape per candidate
steps.detail: candidate_shape is recorded; assertion_count is not. Needed to show a multi-assertion candidate was evaluated as one.

progress.note: assertion_count recorded on every candidate via count_assertions(); import ordered

steps.summary: assertion_count now recorded beside candidate_shape, so a collapsed multi-assertion candidate is distinguishable in the artifact

steps.title: Prove a five-assertion completion is not collapsed
steps.detail: Explicit test that all five assertions survive parsing AND all five execute, not merely that the text is retained.
steps.summary: covered by the same commit: 8 tests including the fifth-assertion-only mutant proof

steps.title: Label the successor evaluation protocol
steps.detail: Distinct run names and artifacts so legacy single-assertion results remain valid historical results rather than being overwritten.

progress.note: denominators separated; receipt written with source hashes and directory-conflict refusal

steps.summary: successor protocol declared: name, version, source hashes, budgets, timeout, no-reranking rule, raw-output storage, legacy preservation; 10 tests including directory-confusion refusal

steps.title: Regenerate base and SFT comparisons under the successor
steps.detail: Evaluation only, not training. Base and relearning, ablation_dev then locked val.

progress.note: pilot analysed: model emits 2.87 assertions/output but successor scores worse; 97.6% of the gap is 128-token truncation
1024-token rerun: truncation removed (481->49 incomplete) and the gap persists; conjunction confirmed as the mechanism

steps.summary: successor protocol measured on ablation_dev at two completion budgets; legacy 0.7159 vs successor 0.5480, gap survives truncation removal

steps.title: Audit the 128-token completion limit
steps.detail: Completion-token percentiles, finish_reason, count ending on length, incomplete ASTs, assertions lost. Raise only if measured.
steps.summary: completion lengths measured at 128 and 1024; ceiling was binding on the trained arm only (p90 128->141, unparseable 481->49) and worth +0.0074 kill@8

steps.title: Cost a repository prompt/completion allocation
steps.detail: 2048 prompt + 1024 completion cannot fit a 2048 sequence length. Either raise sequence length with a GPU-memory preflight or pick a measured allocation. Never silently truncate.
steps.summary: --max-sequence-tokens and --generation-completion-token-limit added with an enforced fit check; 2048 was a project constant, model supports 32768

steps.title: Parallelise the local execution harness across cores
steps.detail: Every analysis runs one sandboxed subprocess at a time on a 32-core machine. The Atheris rerun is 4542 independent runs and is the largest remaining block. Pool the work locally - no Modal, no remote credits - keeping per-execution isolation and timeouts unchanged.

steps.title: Build the progressive mixed curriculum
steps.detail: Deterministic easy/moderate/hard tiers from training-only signals; replay anchors late; record realized mixture per epoch.

steps.title: Rebuild the relearning queue at candidate level
steps.detail: Per-failure-category verified corrections; never train on a raw failed output as a positive label. Permitted prompt enrichment only.

steps.title: Regularize through data first
steps.detail: Unique-lineage sampling, caps, bounded repetition, dedup, diversity monitoring. At most one predeclared parameter challenger after.

steps.title: Atheris per-target failure matrix
steps.detail: Why targets survive: branch not reached, wrong oracle, unsupported input shape, budget, timeout, harness defect, equivalent mutant.

steps.title: Write the research report
steps.detail: Deferred behind P0-P2 so it can describe the successor protocol.

superseded_note: B1-B3 are complete and retained. B4 (report) and B5 (publish) are deferred behind P0-P2 rather than cancelled; the report must describe the successor protocol, so writing it before P0 would date it.
out_of_scope: DPO - explicitly out of scope; easy examples serve as SFT replay anchors

open_decision_before_p1.question: Should the arm emit fewer, surer assertions, or should scoring move to per-assertion rather than per-candidate?
open_decision_before_p1.why_it_blocks_p1: It changes what the curriculum optimises for. Tiering examples by difficulty is the wrong objective if the real failure is that a candidate conjoins more assertions than the model can get right.

evidence.truncation_ruled_out: incomplete ASTs fell 481 -> 49 at a 1024-token budget while the kill gap moved less than a point

open_decision_before_p1.status: AWAITING THE USER. Do not start P1 before this is settled.

must_rerun.atheris: All six Atheris result sets, 4542 runs, are invalid: the targets were never coverage-instrumented (740 of 757 logs warn, 697 ended at a 1-byte corpus) and reference/mutant shared argument objects so identical implementations could disagree. Both fixed; the runs are not redone. This is P5.
must_rerun.not_invalidated: Every Oneiros base and SFT evaluation. The audit defects touched provenance, the sealed-final freeze, the Atheris baseline and resume identity - none touched generation or scoring of those runs.

execution_note: Local CPU only. Modal is present in the repo but deliberately unused: no credits are to be spent, and this machine has 32 cores and 137 GB of RAM sitting idle.
